_comment: Explicit base URLs, each [value, why]. A valid one builds a client; an invalid one raises the invalid-request error when the client is built. Surrounding whitespace and trailing slashes are dropped first.
valid: http to localhost with a trailing dot
invalid: a query, which the endpoint path would be appended to
a fragment, which the endpoint path would be appended to
a backslash before the host: a WHATWG parser sends this to evil.example
a backslash before the host, with a port
a backslash in an https authority
a user name and password on https
http to localhost in fullwidth letters: only the three plain spellings count
http to localhost with two trailing dots
